string.text: I, professor Kruglov, am deleting the results of our research for the sake of science and humanity as a whole. Dangerous knowledge must not pass into the hands of irresponsible people who will seek to use it for the achievement of their criminal objectives. Those who read this note should know that our group was shot down above the Wild Territory by mercenaries led by a notorious cutthroat called Wolfhound. By the time you read this we will probably be dead.

... as it turns out, the emissions affect primarily the advanced spheres of cognitive activity. Experiments show that only humans and animals with developed cognitive processes, such as dogs and horses, are susceptible to these emissions. Of the above, only humans enter a state of trance - in animals the effect is limited to a strong feeling of fear. Judging by this evidence, it would be reasonable to conclude that the emissions are tailored specifically towards the human brain. Extensive studies on "volunteers" have shown that subjects will leave the trance state if given medical treatment. We also developed experimental devices that will protect, to a certain extent, the human brain from these emissions. According to our calculations, the source of these emissions is located in the center of Lake Yantar. The source itself is likely to be artificial in nature, which means that it likely can be disabled like an ordinary technological device. There is also the danger of criminals attempting to reach the source of the emissions and gaining control over it.
So the Brain Scorcher is man-made?

12.01.2012 
 God damn my bosses... They just won't leave an old man alone. First Mesa, then some strange town in Eastern Europe. And now they send poor little Gordon into the endless Ukrainian plains. As if the right man in the wrong place can make all the difference. Here's your crowbar, now go and have fun. 
 
 20.03.2012 
 Made it into the Zone. Are there really no Combine here? Who am I going to fight then? I'm not finding my bearings too well in this place. I had to give my pistol away for a can of meat. Damn goon Sidorovich... 
 
 26.04.2012 
 The blowout has started. The Barkeep told me to hide my ass and keep it hidden. I chased some rats out of an abandoned tunnel. I hope to wait out the bad weather in here... Is that someone snoring deeper in the tunnels, or is it just my imagination?

Yesterday Romantic and I received orders to retreat. As we walked with him from the military warehouses to the bar, we met a strange vagabond: tall, lean, hunched over. He wore a filthy cloak, stubby boots, and a rusty rifle on his side. Behind him he carried a sack tied with a thick rope, and he kept on glancing back as if making sure he wasn't followed. Romantic whispered to me that he did not like the look of this guy and approached the passerby to ask him something, when suddenly the strange man threw his bag far into the bushes, raised his shotgun and shot the Romantic right in the chest! How fortunate that my partner was in full combat gear, otherwise that would've been it... Without hesitation, I grabbed the hobo's shotgun and smashed him in the head with it, knocking him out clean. I checked on my friend: fortunately the buckshot did not pierce the kevlar weave of his vest. My friend's ribs were badly bruised and he had trouble catching his breath, but once he recovered, we interrogated the bastard together. What we discovered made our hair stand on end in horror: the vile fellow was a cannibal. He would take a rookie on a raid promising riches, then once they were alone the cannibal would kill him, then dismember him and eat some of his body parts; the rest would be preserved in salt and bagged up outside the Bar and buried there. Judging by the accounts of our captive, he had already been engaged in such things before he came to the Zone, but we were not interested in the details. I had a look through his bag, and what I saw inside made me lose my appetite for two whole days. Once we were done with him, we shot the freak without a word. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I stashed some valuables in the hangar on the path to the Bar from Garbage, behined one of the tanks. Not a lot of people go there, so I don't think they'll find it.%c[default]

After what happened with that maniac, I keep looking at the faces of the stalkers I meet. Who knows, maybe there's more of these degenerates among us, hiding behind a mask of decency. I'd rather not think about that. \Why are we stopping? The Captain kept repeating that everything was prepared and thought out. And they found someone to escort us, a clown, who acts like a tough guy at every step, like a novice. He looks like he's experienced, but there's still something wrong about him. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]Right behind the western roadblock, under the bush behind the fence, I stashed some of the stuff. The area is tough there, so no bastard would dare to sneak around.%c[default]

The temporary delay before a serious operation was very taxing on my nerves, and my nerves have been going to hell lately already. I even thought of ordering a sedative from the traders or scientists, but then I thought better of it: I need to keep a clear head. And then Dry went somewhere with this escort and disappeared. No sign of him, nor of that dude, and night is swiftly approaching. Should I go look for them before it gets dark? \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I put my backpack with my gear in one of the nooks behind the trailer on the path from the Bar to the Wild Territory. Don't forget it.%c[default]

After we camped at Rostok, the situation remained unclear. The vanguard group promised to get in touch in three days, but five days have passed, and no word from them...
 I recently had a wandering veteran tell me a story about a stalker named Death. I was told he walks around the Zone and asks everyone he comes across what time it is. And to those who don't tell him what time it is, he simply replies: "If I ask you again in the next life, I want you to answer" - and after a while all those who hear that reply are found dead, and without any visible injuries. Who the hell knows, maybe it was a psychopathic mass murderer rampaging through the Zone, or maybe it's just a campfire story, but I've been winding up my watch every morning since then regardless. 
 So why haven't I heard anything... Any luck with the messenger? I don't think so, Trofim is an experienced stalker... 
 Unexpectedly, our escort came by and said that there's important news. I should go somewhere with him, but in the meantime, I'll leave our camp in the care of the Storyteller. 

 %c[255,255,128,0]I was in the old abandoned garage, and there's a lot of junk and equipment in there. Squeezed between the trucks and got stuck. Barely made it out, but the strap of my backpack broke off and I left it lying there somewhere.%c[default]
夜に現れる狙撃手を始末する。奴は真夜中に姿を見せ、夜明けには消えてしまう。狙えるのは夜だけだ。給水塔のそばを探す。
